summary: Phase 6 Pacman integration is complete and meets all requirements. All four FEATs implemented correctly: pacman_parser (FEAT-001) with proper multi-value field handling, PacmanIndex (FEAT-002) with FTS5 search and mtime-based rebuild detection, PacmanBackend (FEAT-003) with conflict detection and graceful RPC fallback, and MainWindow integration (FEAT-004) with PendingRebootBanner and ConflictPending error handling. Pattern adherence confirmed: PacmanBackend matches FlatpakBackend pattern, PacmanIndex matches FlathubIndex pattern. RPC correctness verified: pacman_parser imported inside functions for graceful degradation, no module-level imports. Conflict detection implemented: remove() checks Required By via pacman -Qi and fails with ConflictPending when user packages depend on the target. Test coverage comprehensive: 343 tests pass (1 skipped), all new modules have tests, fixture files present and correct. Code quality excellent: 0 ruff violations, proper docstrings, type hints throughout. Integration verified: MainWindow instantiates both PacmanBackend and PacmanIndex, merges pacman apps in _refresh_pacman_installed, shows PendingRebootBanner after successful operations, handles ConflictPending with QMessageBox warnings.
